---
name: Skill proposal
about: Propose a new skill or a major reshape of an existing skill
labels: [skill-proposal]
---

## Summary
Describe the proposed skill or reshape.

## Why this belongs in the repo
Explain why this is a reusable class of work, not a one-off incident or company-specific playbook.

## Existing skills reviewed
List related skills already in the repo and explain why they are insufficient without this change.

## Trigger and boundary sketch
- When should this skill load?
- When should it *not* load?
- Which adjacent skills could be confused with it?

## Proposed structure
- Overview
- When to Use
- Workflow
- Common Pitfalls
- Verification Checklist
- Examples

## Example prompts or eval ideas
Give at least one example prompt and one idea for how to judge answer quality.
